messages:
Michelle: Morning all — quick async huddle. Drop 1) what you finished yesterday, 2) any blockers, 3) what you're doing today. I'll kick off with a note about the console rollout.

Alex: Yesterday: landed the dedupe change for batcher and ran perf tests (latency down ~12%). Blocker: need a quick review on the batching hotfix PR (#4823) — waiting on final LGTM. Today: slice the rollout and watch canary.

Raj: Yesterday: infra cleanup for gpu autoscaler; removed stale taints. Blocker: need creds to the staging BigQuery dataset to validate telemetry joins (pinging infra for access). Today: working on autoscaler policy tuning.

Taylor: Yesterday: finished doc for model version pinning in private deploys. Blocker: none. Today: pairing with @Alex for rollout checklist and smoke tests.

Ivy: Yesterday: worked on Redwood Optimize metric dashboard; hooked up latency histograms. Blocker: small data mismatch in token cost calc — suspicious rounding in the billing lambda. Today: debugging billing function and will open a tiny PR.

Dana: Yesterday: triaged support tickets from last weekend; escalated the one with customer X to AE. Blocker: waiting on dump from their engineering team to reproduce. Today: prepping CS notes for the weekly sync.

Alex: @Raj — I can grant you BQ access if you DM me the project id. Also pinged @dana about the support ticket repro steps.

Raj: thanks, Alex — sent the project id.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy succeeded for service=redwood-console, image=redwood/console:v0.12.3 — 3/3 healthy :rocket:

Michelle: FYI — townhall at 15:00 PT today. If you need to be oncall during that window, pls add a note here.

Taylor: Noted — I'm oncall but can swap with Dana for overlap if needed.

Dana: I can cover townhall overlap. :thumbsup:

Ivy: Quick ask — who's able to review my PR when it's up? it's tiny (billing rounding fix) and I want it in before canary next deploy.

Alex: I'll take it after lunch.

Michelle: Thanks all. If anything blocks your work today pls DM the person listed or drop a follow-up here. Small reminder: if you haven't filled retrospectives for the sprint, do it by EOD.

Raj: One more thing — experiments infra maintenance tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC, heads up (low-risk).

Taylor: Good to know, thanks.

Michelle: Closing thread — feel free to continue updates inline.
